transcript.note: Round 1, full layout from geography. Anchored the deg>=3 interchanges first and hand-verified winding order at every one of them with atan2 (e.g. Taipei Main's five neighbours 24/58/36/23/40 keep their real cyclic order NE/W/SW/S/ESE as 90/180/225/270/315 on the grid). Downtown core is an orthogonal grid: R vertical on col 10 (CKS Memorial->Taipei Main->Zhongshan->Minquan W->Mingde), G Songshan branch horizontal on row 11, O vertical on col 11 (Guting->Dongmen->Zhongxiao Xinsheng->Songjiang Nanjing->Xingtian Temple) then bending west via 45s to Dadaocheng/Sanchong. Airport line is a horizontal corridor on row 12 (Sanchong->Xinbei Industrial Park->Chang Gung->Terminal 1) turning due south on col 0, matching its real west-then-south course. Tamsui tail keeps the real jog: Beitou NE of Guandu, R dips SW Beitou->Guandu then N to Hongshulin; V light rail fans NW with the Kanding spur due north. Circular line forms its real L: Dapinglin->Shisizhang horizontal, Jingan->Zhonghe 45, Zhonghe->Banqiao horizontal, then vertical up col 5 through Touqianzhuang to Xinbei Industrial Park. Compass kept monotone except a few <=20-unit squash ties in the Tamsui/V cluster and the far southwest, checked pairwise by gx/gy. Four segments stay non-H/V/45 by deliberate trade-off (Dingpu->Haishan, Banqiao->Ximen, Shisizhang->Jingan, Sanchong->Daqiaotou) because straightening any of them breaks a winding order or a neighbouring 45; hv 44/74, hvd 70/74 by my own count, no two points share a cell.
